2. After a long lapse of 10 years the petitioner who was married in the meantime filed Miscellaneous Case No. 408 of 1993 before the learned District Judge, Dhaka for removal of the respondent as guardian of the lunatic and her appointment in that place on various allegations which were denied by her. By an order dated 28 September 1995 the learned District Judge rejected the prayer of the petitioner and dismissed the miscellaneous case observing— 

 “I am led to hold that the O.P. Khodeja Begum has not failed to discharge her duties as yet, as a guardian of the person and property of the lunatic Sohrabuddin who seems to be happy with his sister, the O.P. and it is my considered opinion that though the petitioner is the daughter of till lunatic the well-being and welfare of the lunatic cannot be better served by the petitioner under the present circumstances of the case and as such the guardianship of the O.P. is not liable to be cancelled."
